variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: an actual 1920x1080 screenshot of the current Chinese dark Cthulhu card game. Deliver a single full-screen polished UI mockup retaining the same 16:9 composition, preferably 1920x1080 or higher at exactly the same ratio. This is a local redesign of ONLY the UPPER RIGHT CORNER, not a redesign of the whole screen.

STRICT LOCKED AREAS: preserve every pixel/composition/detail outside approximately x=1475..1920, y=0..650. Leave the left player portrait/panel, four other player panels across the top, all their names and HP/SAN bars and hand cards, left flag, skulls/candles, cavern environment, all three perspective card piles, the entire bottom hand fan and readable existing card art/text/proportions, counters, prompt bar at y650, and the three large action buttons in the bottom right completely unchanged. No reframing, no cropping, no new UI elsewhere. Especially DO NOT paint a replacement card design. Preserve the existing FOREGROUND TENTACLE rising from lower right: its exact silhouette and position must remain and overlap IN FRONT OF the lower/right edges of the new log surface. The new log background must visibly go UNDER this tentacle, never float on top of it.

Resolve these five issues within the upper-right region:
1. Replace the old enormous astrology dial with useful compact controls, no astrology/zodiac/constellation symbolism, no expansion-specific motif. Design a coherent edge-integrated turn/control header in muted oxidized brass and blackened material matching the existing fine realistic ornamental trim. Text 回合 3 centered accurately in its painted compartment, subtitle 你的回合 smaller and well inset.
2. Two IDENTIC-size round buttons for pause and settings, equal visible outer ring diameters, level centers, equal internal margins, mechanical double-bar pause icon and gear icon, not typographic characters. They should use former dial area meaningfully, physically set into/overlaid on the same upper framing instead of hanging separately. Preserve perfect circles.
3. Replace the fabric/flag log surface with a credible WRITING RECORD surface. It must not look like another flag or a bright generic framed dialog, nor a separate small clipboard floating in the scene. The log and header connect naturally to the screen's right edge with some ornament cropped outside the screen.
4. Preserve the asymmetric silhouette of this established layout: turn/header projects LEFT most at the top, log's left edge RECESSES RIGHT beneath it, then existing lower action buttons project LEFT again. Do not turn the whole right column into one flat vertical rectangle. Keep the open cave space and do not encroach on the fourth opponent.
5. Log type block follows the new writing surface, is closer to right edge (roughly 20px safe margin at 1920), avoids the left binding/trim, uses refined narrow Chinese serif text comparable in scale/brightness to existing UI. Heading 冒险日志 and sample records: 游戏开始。每人获得四张初始手牌。 / ── 第3回合 · 你 ── / 你摸到了【A2 神圣菇肉】。 / 你选择收入手牌。 / 你恢复了3HP。 Text must sit comfortably WITHIN the artwork; maintain good contrast without white glowing letters.

Art direction: cohesive painterly realism of the existing game, aged black bronze/thin worn dull gold edging, desaturated charcoal/deep green-black, subtle tactile corrosion and fine wear. Rich material edges but controlled ornament. No cartoon thick outlines, chunky plastic controls, bright cyan glow, clean vector UI, oversized swirls, bright beige parchment, large new medallions. Match original screenshot's darkness and balance, do not brighten the whole image. The new corner must feel part of the physical surrounding ornamental scene, with foreground occlusion and partial offscreen border continuity. No design annotations, version labels, arrows or dimension lines in the image.
VARIANT A: A recessed dark graphite writing sheet secured beneath an aged metal header rail. The right-edge mounting and subtle torn/bent PAPER corners distinguish it from cloth; no fabric texture, tassels, vertical hanging point or banner shape. Use fine quietly irregular antiqued-bronze left edging, a few layered paper edges exiting the right screen edge, and a lower corner hidden beneath the existing foreground tentacle. The surface should remain dark enough to harmonize with the cave and right action rail, no closed heavy rectangle. The header has a broad elegant turn plaque to the left and a pair of identical modest inset control discs to its right; no empty ornament filling the removed dial area.
